newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Glencore Brazil says sold 45,000 tns soy to U.S.
newsitem.headline: Glencore Brazil says sold 45,000 tns soy to U.S.

text.p: Glencore Brazil has sold 45,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans to a U.S. firm, a trader at the firm confirmed.
"We did. It was 45,000 tonnes soybeans," he said in response to a query over rumors Glencore made the deal.
The trader said he was not certain of the shipment date but it would probably be April or May.
"I'm not sure but I think it will be April, May, very soon," he said.
He could not confirm a price either but said it was based on current premiums.
Brazilian soybeans are currently quoted at a discount of 18/12 cents per bushel against Chicago for April shipment and 20/18 cents for May shipment, according to brokerage Alianca Corretores.
